info.title: Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals Universal API
info.description: Manage loyalty customers, points, referrals, and redemptions

put.description: Updates a customer's points balance in Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

customerEmail.description: Customer email address. Required if customerId is not provided.

pointAdjustmentAmount.description: Positive values add points and negative values remove points.

applyAdjustmentToPointsEarned.description: Whether the adjustment should also change the customer's total points earned value.

historyTitle.description: Optional override for the history description shown to the customer.

visibleToCustomer.description: Whether the manual adjustment should be visible to the customer.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the point adjustment was created.

customerId.description: Yotpo customer identifier affected by the adjustment.

id.description: Unique identifier of the point adjustment event.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the point adjustment was last updated.

put.description: Creates or updates customer records in Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The identifier used to uniquely identify the customer in your system.

phoneNumber.description: The customer's phone number in E.164 format.

countryIsoCode.description: Use only if phone number cannot be sent in full E.164 format.

hasAccount.description: Whether the customer has an account with the eCommerce platform.

optedIn.description: Whether the customer should be opted in to the loyalty program.

platformAccountCreatedAt.description: Date and time when the customer created an account with your store.

tags.description: A comma-separated list of tags or collections this customer belongs to. This overwrites existing tags.

optedInAt.description: Date and time when the customer was opted in to the loyalty program.

post.description: Creates an order in Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

currencyCode.description: The ISO currency code for the order.

userAgent.description: The customer's browser or device user agent.

customerId.description: The identifier used to uniquely identify the customer in your system.

status.description: Order status used to determine how Yotpo should process rewards and discount removal.

createdAt.description: Timestamp describing when this order was placed.

couponCode.description: Comma-separated list of coupon codes used on the order.

ignoreIpUa.description: Ignore IP address and user-agent fraud checks for this order.

discountAmountCents.description: Total discount amount applied to the order in cents.

clerkEmployeeId.description: Employee ID of the store clerk who processed the transaction.

clerkName.description: Name of the store clerk who processed the transaction.

storeAddress.description: Street address of the store location for the order.

storeCity.description: City of the store location for the order.

storeState.description: State or province of the store location for the order.

channelType.description: Order channel, such as online or offline.

items[].id.description: Unique identifier of a purchased product line item.

items[].name.description: Customer-facing product name for a purchased item.

items[].priceCents.description: Unit price for the item in cents.

items[].collections.description: Comma-separated collections or tags for the item.

items[].type.description: Product category or type for the purchased item.

items[].vendor.description: Vendor or manufacturer for the purchased item.

customer.tags.description: Comma-separated customer tags. Include this if customer-based include or exclude rules are configured.

customer.hasAccount.description: Whether the customer has an account with the ecommerce platform.

customer.optedIn.description: Whether the customer should be opted in to the loyalty program.

customer.optedInAt.description: Timestamp when the customer opted in to the loyalty program.

post.description: Creates a redemption in Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

redemptionOptionId.description: Unique identifier of the redemption option being redeemed.

customerEmail.description: Customer email address. Use one customer identifier for the redemption request.

posAccountId.description: Customer identifier from your POS system. Use one customer identifier for the redemption request.

phoneNumber.description: Customer phone number in E.164 format. Use one customer identifier for the redemption request.

customerId.description: Customer identifier from your system. Use one customer identifier for the redemption request.

delayPointsDeduction.description: Only deduct points when the associated order is later received.

currency.description: Currency code to use when the account is configured for multi-currency.

pointsToRedeem.description: Point amount to redeem for variable redemptions.

approved.description: Whether the redemption has been approved.

approvedAt.description: Timestamp when the redemption was approved, when available.

atCheckout.description: Whether the redemption is associated with checkout.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the redemption was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the redemption record.

isAdmin.description: Whether the redemption was created by an admin flow.

isPos.description: Whether the redemption was created from a POS flow.

rewardText.description: Reward text or generated redemption text returned by Yotpo.

thirdPartyId.description: Third-party identifier for the generated code, when available.

thirdPartyRuleId.description: Third-party rule identifier for the generated code, when available.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the redemption was last updated.

post.description: Creates a refund in Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund in your system.

currency.description: Refund currency code. Required when using multi-currency.

items[].id.description: Identifier of a refunded line item. Must match the item ID used when the order was created.

items[].quantity.description: Quantity refunded for the line item.

get.description: Retrieves customer details from Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: customerEmail
parameters.description: The customer's email address. Required if no pos_account_id, customer_id, or phone_number is passed.

schema.description: The customer's email address. Required if no pos_account_id, customer_id, or phone_number is passed.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The identifier used to uniquely identify the customer in your system. Required if no customer_email, pos_account_id, or phone_number is passed.

schema.description: The identifier used to uniquely identify the customer in your system. Required if no customer_email, pos_account_id, or phone_number is passed.

parameters.name: posAccountId
parameters.description: The identifier used to uniquely identify the customer in your POS system. Required if no customer_email, customer_id, or phone_number is passed.

schema.description: The identifier used to uniquely identify the customer in your POS system. Required if no customer_email, customer_id, or phone_number is passed.

parameters.name: phoneNumber
parameters.description: The customer's phone number in E.164 format. Required if no customer_email, pos_account_id, or customer_id is passed.

schema.description: The customer's phone number in E.164 format. Required if no customer_email, pos_account_id, or customer_id is passed.

parameters.name: countryIsoCode
parameters.description: Only use if phone_number cannot be sent in full E.164 format.

schema.description: Only use if phone_number cannot be sent in full E.164 format.

parameters.name: withReferralCode
parameters.description: Return referral code information when set to true.

schema.description: Return referral code information when set to true.

parameters.name: withHistory
parameters.description: Return point earning and redemption history when set to true.

schema.description: Return point earning and redemption history when set to true.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

creditBalance.description: Customer credit balance in store currency.

creditBalanceInCustomerCurrency.description: Customer credit balance in the customer's currency.

hasStoreAccount.description: Whether the customer has a store account.

historyItems.description: Point earning and redemption history items returned when history is requested.

lastPurchaseAt.description: Timestamp of the customer's most recent purchase.

lastSeenAt.description: Timestamp when the customer was last seen.

nextPointsExpireOn.description: Date of the next points expiration event.

optedInAt.description: Date when the customer opted in.

optIn.description: Whether the customer has opted in.

perksRedeemed.description: Number of perks the customer has redeemed.

pointsEarned.description: Total points earned by the customer.

pointsExpireAt.description: Timestamp when the customer's points expire.

thirtyPartyId.description: Provider legacy typo field mapped from `thirty_party_id`.

totalPurchases.description: Total number of purchases recorded for the customer.

vipTierActionsCompleted.description: Progress already completed toward the current VIP tier thresholds.

vipTierEntryDate.description: Timestamp when the customer entered the current VIP tier.

vipTierExpiration.description: Timestamp when the current VIP tier expires.

vipTierMaintenanceRequirements.description: Requirements needed to maintain the current VIP tier.

vipTierName.description: Current VIP tier name when the merchant uses VIP tiers.

vipTierUpgradeRequirements.description: Requirements needed to upgrade to the next VIP tier.
